answer: In a nebula of anonymous agents, require each identity to post a sable-staked bond locked in a public mesa registry before it can trade. The bond is slashed if the agent double-spends or floods the market with fake bids, and honest work slowly earns it back with interest. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand bonds, so a Sybil attacker must lock up real capital per identity, while one honest agent pays once and keeps trading.
